_meta.description: The Advice Translator (docs/m4-spec.md section 2.4): common advice, each with the rule that decides whether it applies to this person. Verdicts are applies, partly, or unlearn, each with one sentence built from the person's numbers by the engine.

advice.statement: Save three to six months of expenses.
Pay off all debt before investing.
Never touch retirement money before 59 and a half.
Roth is always better when you're young.
An emergency fund has to be cash.
